item.title: Kingston mayor proposes occupancy tax on short-term rentals
item.description: As of May 2025, about 150 housing units in the City of Kingston were operating as short-term rentals, out of an estimated 11,049 total housing units. That is about 1.36% of Kingston’s housing stock.
